implementation: One inert common74 successor stages the existing authenticated ingress worker, its helper, constrained unit and absent-only private-directory activator. Frozen common73 and all predecessors remain unchanged.
The unit grants ReadWritePaths only for the fixed ingress root; StateDirectory remains the native receipt store, preventing systemd-managed ownership repair of retained ingress evidence.

The activator validates loaded restrictions and four inactive services before root-held nofollow ancestor checks, absent-only creation, bounded emptiness, worker ownership/mode checks and held/named inode joins. Partial creation is retained and prevents retry.
Preparation pins the complete real common74 report, derives the actual staged worker artifact, and preserves seven-writer semantics and seven broker measurement source bindings.

Current static pins, preparation, request, identity and independent-verification envelopes are v2. The selected identity/request inventory grows from 26 to 28 files; the helper has protected-root and worker-process-root byte joins, while the activator is root-only source evidence.
Existing independent descriptor/process readers are reused. No generic framework, runtime argv change or caller-selected worker override was introduced.
review_findings_resolved: Replace unbounded listdir allocation in the fixed-root provisioner with a bounded context-managed empty-directory check.
Keep the inherited new-dependencies inventory semantic: add only the new helper, while all four replacements are bound by the full file manifest and explicit output pins.
Preserve frozen v1 evidence and refuse its promotion through current v2 preparation and identity boundaries; coherent local manifest rehashing cannot bypass the complete reviewed stage pin.
Treat process-root helper bytes and root-only activator bytes as source observations, not proof of loaded code or the full 74-file installed state.
pipeline_command: /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12 -S -B scripts/phase3_pipeline.py run phase3-ingress-profile native-common-ingress-migration native-common-preparation native-common-worker-provisioning native-common-identity native-common-process-verifier

reviewed_input_closure.meaning: Explicit transitive local imports plus pinned source/payload inputs; AST local-import review found no missing inputs. Existing preparation and worker-provisioning closures add the new stager, existing ingress renderer and helper. New profile and migration stages inherit only their required explicit closures; historical test discovery is not added. Identity/verifier path closures are unchanged and bind their changed source/test bytes. Runner and interpreter remain unchanged.

limitations: Checks use temporary inert DESTDIRs, mocked process/kernel/descriptor observations and fake provisioning filesystem calls. No host or guest service, owned live fixture, real activation or measurement directory was invoked.
Current controller/guest orchestration still needs migration to the common74 profile and v2 prepared request. Historical controller observations must not be relabeled.
The selected 28-file protected/process identity boundary is not the complete installed 74-file inventory, loaded Python provenance, continuous immutability or hostile-root protection.

Ingress requires actual external boot/active-time-namespace observations from one collector and effective broker-final evidence. These source and envelope changes alone establish no elapsed time, sink acknowledgment, effect or causal attribution.
Real prepared-attempt and workload callbacks, remaining admission families, RUN event/response/attribution and meaningful sensor-health coverage remain incomplete.
Final31 and 100-attempt/100-pair acceptance stays blocked until shared deployment, complete independent-verifier inventory and real workload/timing prerequisites are complete.
next_dependency: S2: migrate the existing common host/guest execution path to the common74 profile and v2 prepared request; consume the original commitment once, independently join actual ingress, both one-collector boot/active-namespace observations and effective broker-final records, and wire real workload, sink/attribution and verified cleanup callbacks. Remaining admission and RUN implementation lanes must converge on this same deployment before freeze.
checkpoint_commit: Create one signed local commit, verify signature and clean tree, and retain its hash in ignored .aragorn/phase3-batch-<short-hash>-checkpoint.json. No automatic push.
